subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some pictures looked like flowers.”?
options: Others said it looked like twisted metal and wasted money.
Others gave very short answers, like "food" or "sleep."
Others felt the darker painting had looked more mysterious.
Others looked like rivers or fireworks.

本文沒有陳述「Others gave very short answers, like 'food' or 'sleep.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

本文可直接核對「Some pictures looked like flowers. Others looked like rivers or fireworks.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
